subject.title: Document hermetic-agent evidence demo with Crabbox

question: Should Crabbox core docs include and promote this hermetic-agent case study with links to a contributor-owned demo, or should the pattern be documented only as a generic proof-artifact recipe?
rationale: The underlying Crabbox feature already exists, but README/feature-index promotion of an external workflow is a docs/product-positioning choice under AGENTS.md's generic-example guidance.

options.title: Accept a genericized case study
options.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/1021 and require neutral wording, stable links, and docs-link validation before merge.

options.title: Keep the docs as a recipe only
options.body: Ask the PR to remove external-demo promotion and document the same proof-artifact pattern with neutral repository names and commands.

options.title: Decline core-docs promotion
options.body: Close the PR and leave the contributor demo outside Crabbox docs if maintainers do not want external workflow case studies in core documentation.

recommendation.title: Accept a genericized case study
recommendation.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/1021 and require neutral wording, stable links, and docs-link validation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current README/docs positioning and proof-artifact docs baseline trace most clearly to this history.
